verdict.rationale: Supabase docs confirm automatic daily backups for Pro/Team/Enterprise plans (supabase-docs-11), but there is no evidence of a visible backup schedule UI or a self-serve restore flow. Independent reporting (Val Town/HN) found Supabase's nightly pg_dump-based backups actually took the production database offline every night due to write contention, which the CEO confirmed and said they'd address by moving to PITR — a concrete hands-on contradiction of a smooth, reliable backup process. missing for 10: documented restore workflow/UI, evidence of configurable backup schedule, and confirmation that the pg_dump outage issue has been resolved.
